name: gather
description: GATHER — golf performance, charity and monthly prize-draw platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @gather/shared" "npm run dev -w @gather/api" "npm run dev -w @gather/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @gather/api && npm run build -w @gather/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
